import kit

types = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": ["S0", "S1", "S2", "S3"]},
         {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
         {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
            "requires": ["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "ST", "S3"]]}]
machine = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2", "S3"], "initial": "S0",
           "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": [
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "a", "cost": 5, "when": None},
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S2", "command": "b", "cost": 2, "when": None},
               {"from": "S2", "to": "S1", "command": "c", "cost": 3, "when": None},
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "d", "cost": 5, "when": None},
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S3", "command": "e", "cost": 1, "when": None},
               {"from": "S3", "to": "S1", "command": "f", "cost": 4, "when": None},
               {"from": "S1", "to": "S0", "command": "g", "cost": 1, "when": None},
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S2", "command": "h", "cost": 1,
                "when": ["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "ST", "S2"]]},
               {"from": "S2", "to": "S3", "command": "i", "cost": 1,
                "when": ["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "ST", "S2"]]},
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S3", "command": "j", "cost": 100, "when": None},
           ]}
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
out, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print(plan["slots"], plan["variables"], plan["types"])


def ktest(state, message="go", result=0):
    chars = [ord(c) for c in message.ljust(4, "\x00")[:4]]
    values = [state_index[state]] + chars + [result]
    return kit.encode([(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in
                       zip(plan["slots"], values)])


state_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(machine["states"])}


def run(state, message="go", result=0):
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(state, message, result)}]
    out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
    return out["records"][0], out["corpus"]


print(run("S0"))
r, c = run("S0")
assert r["status"] == "UNREACHABLE" or True
# S0 is the initial state: no preparation, the message is still appended
assert r == {"status": "READY", "case": 0, "model_result": False}, r
assert c[0]["commands"] == ["go"] and c[0]["cost"] == 0, c

# target S1: cost 5 via 'a' or 'd' or 'bc' or 'ef'; hop count then lex picks 'a'
r, c = run("S1")
assert r["status"] == "READY", r
assert c[0]["commands"] == ["a", "go"] and c[0]["cost"] == 5, c

# target S2: b(2) vs h(1) guarded by st==S2 -> enabled here, so cost 1, ['h']
r, c = run("S2")
assert r["status"] == "READY", r
assert c[0]["commands"] == ["h", "go"] and c[0]["cost"] == 1, c

# target S3: entry predicate requires st == S3 so S3 is filtered... check order
r, c = run("S3")
assert r["status"] == "READY", r
assert c[0]["commands"] == ["e", "go"] and c[0]["cost"] == 1, c

# S3 target with the guard off (st is S3, so h/i are disabled)
# unreachable check: use a machine without e/j paths by targeting a fresh state
print("basic state ok")

# --- filtering precedes reachability, reachability precedes dedup -------
campaign2 = dict(campaign)
campaign2["modules"] = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]],
                         "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
campaign = campaign2
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest("S1", "x")},
                    {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest("S1", "y", 1)},
                    {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest("S2", "x")}]
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(out["records"])
print(out["corpus"])
assert [r["status"] for r in out["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE", "READY"]
assert out["records"][1]["model_result"] is True      # result never identifies
assert out["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "x"]
assert out["corpus"][1]["commands"] == ["h", "x"]
assert [w for c in out["corpus"] for w in c["witnesses"]] == [0, 1, 2]
assert [c["cost"] for c in out["corpus"]] == [5, 1]
print("STATE OK")
